source_structures: FREQUENT REVALUATIONS | INSTITUTIONAL METHODOLOGY | Our Institutional Valuation Methodology
notes: Counted from page-001.png: the document_context row, plus six printed valuation facts. Under INSTITUTIONAL METHODOLOGY, the board's adoption of the valuation guidelines (oversight), the guidelines' overarching principle (method), and who administers them (valuer). Under FREQUENT REVALUATIONS, the daily NAV calculation, the approximately 250 days a year on which the NAV is published, and the peers' twelve times a year. The 250-day figure reached neither lane and is added. The opening paragraphs are industry background: the NAV per share definition is a generic definition, which carries evidence_class definition and is not allowed at CORE, and 'more frequent independent valuations guide the methodology' is mission language. B's 'many NAV sponsors calculate their NAV on a monthly basis' restates the peer frequency from the same sentence and would give one measure two values.

source_structures: APPRAISAL BASED METHODOLOGY — PROOF POINT | DEBT MARK TO MARKET | INDEPENDENT APPRAISALS
notes: Counted from page-002.png: under INDEPENDENT APPRAISALS, the quarterly appraisal cadence, the initial cost basis for newly acquired properties, when those join the appraisal cycle, the appraisal factors, the daily NAV factors, the share class NAV adjustment, SitusAMC as valuation advisor, its compensation basis, its final decision authority, its board reporting line, ALPS as NAV calculation agent, the administrator's daily calculation, review and approval before publication, and daily website publication; under DEBT MARK TO MARKET, the no-debt-mark-to-market policy and the carrying basis for borrowings; under APPRAISAL BASED METHODOLOGY, dispositions closing within 1% of the most recent third-party appraised value. B wrote 34 rows by lifting noun phrases out of single sentences, so values such as 'interest expense' and 'portfolio income' are not facts and cannot be read without the sentence they came from; each such sentence is published once, in the fact that states it. The right-hand argument about what debt mark to market would do to a fund is not a valuation this fund performs. The $100 million property worked example is explicitly hypothetical and CORE allows only actual or redacted evidence. The $1.3 billion of dispositions across 50 properties and SitusAMC's own $500 billion valuation book have no controlled valuation category, and B typed both fair_value or input while dropping the magnitude word, leaving values of '$1.3' and '$500'.

Forward-looking statement disclosure, SUMMARY OF RISK FACTORS, copyright and dealer manager notice. Risk factors and disclaimers are named reference content, so the label is REFERENCE_ONLY; both lanes reached the right zero with the NO_ELIGIBLE_DATA label. The 5% per quarter and 20% per annum repurchase limits printed in the first risk factor are a repurchase_limit, which the NAV_Statement family carries and the Valuation family does not.

notes: Counted from page-004.png, an all-narrative page. Fourteen printed figures state a fact about the reporting entity in an allowed category: approximately 3% of each stockholder's May repurchase request satisfied, the $90,630 by which the monthly limitation was exceeded, the $500 small-holder threshold in the repurchase plan, the approximately $9.7 billion aggregate NAV, the 48,372,324 primary offering shares with their four class components, and the 15,132,495 distribution reinvestment plan shares with their four class components. The 0.33% monthly limit is printed twice here but only as a back-reference to the limit set out in the immediately preceding paragraph on page 3, where it is recorded, so it states no new fact and is not counted again.
